# braintrust_prompt (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about an existing Braintrust prompt. Look up by `id` or by `name` + `project_id`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the prompt. Provide either `id` or `name` (with `project_id`).
- `name` (String) The name of the prompt. Provide `name` together with `project_id`, or use `id` instead.
- `project_id` (String) The project the prompt belongs to. Required when looking up by `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of prompt creation.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the prompt.
- `function_type` (String) Optional function type for the prompt.
- `metadata_json` (String) JSON-encoded metadata object returned by the API.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization.
- `prompt_data_json` (String) JSON-encoded prompt_data payload.
- `slug` (String) Slug/identifier of the prompt.
- `tags` (List of String) A list of tags for the prompt.
- `xact_id` (String) Transaction id of the prompt version.
